about_description: Hydrogelogy specialist advising on mine water strategy and groundwater management for Singapore-based copper, gold, and lithium projects. I specialise in groundwater management and mine water strategy for Singapore-based mining and resource development firms. My work addresses water-related challenges in new projects, expansions, and ongoing operations, including support for emerging technologies like in-situ leaching. I combine hydrogeology, groundwater chemistry, environmental science, engineering, and digital technology to tackle water scarcity and regulatory complexities under Singapore standards. I develop practical solutions for environmentally sensitive groundwater systems and manage aquifer recharge schemes, ensuring that production requirements align with sustainable water stewardship in the local context.
services_offered_title: Mine Water Strategy and Groundwater Management; In-Situ Leaching and Recovery Advisory
services_offered_description: Advisory for Singapore-based mining companies and resource developers navigating water constraints. Work aligns with Singapore’s Water Act and NEA environmental guidelines. Scope excludes general civil engineering design or legal permitting representation. Services include hydrogeological system modelling for leaching efficiency, risk assessment of subsurface conditions, and development of water management strategies specific to in-situ processes. Ideal for explorers and operators exploring advanced extraction methods in complex groundwater environments under local regulatory oversight.
relevant_experience: Developed innovative groundwater management solutions that delivered real-world results in environmentally sensitive areas. Helped clients overcome water-related constraints to unlock project value through dewatering management and aquifer recharge schemes.
